edges.subject: GRN
edges.quote: Patients were identified through an active search for granulin precursor gene (GRN) pathogenic variants across the entire database of next-generation sequencing of a commercial laboratory and by contacting attending physicians to check for clinical and radiologic findings compatible with a neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis phenotype.

edges.subject: CLN11 disease
